༄༅/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs chung ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: chung ba bzhugs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bla ma mchog gi zhabs kyi padmor gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /thun mtshams 'od dmar 'dzin pa'i myos ldan ma/ /glog phran ltar g.yo mi 'gyur bde byin ma/ /lha mo mchog gi 'gro 'di rjes bzung mdzod/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs/ /dza landha ra ba dang po'i mgon po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gzhan dag kyang snang mod/ de ni ma thos so/ /'dir ni slob dpon chen po'i bzhed pa 'phags yul grub chen mang po'i gshegs shul/ sgrub thabs chung ba snyan rgyud ma'am las bdun can du 'byung ba'i don/ bla ma'i lung gis iṇḍa bhu ti dang*/ stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rje dang*/ rngon pa'i gzhung sogs las bag tsam kha bskang*/ man ngag zhal nas brgyud pas cung zad gsal bar byas te snying po mdo tsam bri bar bya'o/ /de yang dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di'i byin rlabs kyang nges par thob pas dang por rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bsam la khrus bya/ de nas/ hūṃ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas ma mo bcu spros/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra mutgar sogs brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bla ma yi dam phaiṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs dang*/ de nas skyabs yul rnams rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi la ye shes kyi ngo bo'i dam rdzas kyi rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ baṃ zhes pa bkod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod la me tog dmar pos mchod/ nang mchod des sor mo rnams dang rtsa ba dang*/ sen mo la thig le byas la/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hre~Xṃ hriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan drug gis bdud rtsir phul/

mnyes shing zhu bar lta'o/ /lag pa la sogs pa rnams gnas drug tu byugs pas de dang der lha rnams thim/ srin lag gis bdud rtsi gtor zhing gnas dang mchod pa dang*/ maṇḍal gsang gtor bya/ de nas me long dag pa sindhū ra/ rdul gyis gos pa'i seng ras kyis rtsags la/ g.yon gyi mthe srin lag gis gser gyi smyug gu bzung nas chos 'byung zur gsum pa phyogs bzhi ru dga' 'khyil re/ nang du oṃ gsum ma tshan gsum du bcad pa'i 'og tu baṃ/ steng du ha dang bcas pa bri/ de nyid skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ phaiṃ/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ ye shes sems dpa' rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa sngags kyi yig 'bru dang ro mnyam du gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ añtsa ma naṃ= pādyaṃ= prokṣa naṃ= oṃ āḥhriṃ hūṃ hūṃ haḥhaḥ zhes sha chen gyi spos phul/ oṃ badzra yo gī nī puṣpaṃ dhu paṃ dī paṃ gandhaṃ bā liṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa ma mi rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ so rtsi dang nang mchod dang*/ cang te'u brdung shing rkang brgyad dam/ rtsa sngags kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas/ dzā zhes rang la bsdu ba'am/ gshegs su gsol te phyi rol mchod pa'o/ / oṃ shū'u n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa/ phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba dkar po bzhis brgyan pa/ de'i nang du keng rus kyi phung po la gnas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po 'greng ba'i steng du/ padma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar nyi ma la/ mi ro gser mdog mig gsum nam mkhar blta ba/ de'i steng du baṃ dmar po thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i sems kyi ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang rdo rje phag mo sku mdog se 'bru'i me tog dang dza ba ltar dmar shing 'od zer me ltar 'bar ba/

smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ mche ba'i myu gu can/ spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ g.yas phag gdong nag po gyen du phyogs pa/ nu 'bur rgyas shing lang tsho la bab pa/ 'dod chags chen po kha ṭwāṃ ga dang 'dus pas bde ba rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar thabs dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang*/ mgo bo'i phreng ba can/ skra mtshams su dar dpyangs bcing ba/ g.yon brkyang gis gar stabs can mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /mdun nas g.yas skor gyis 'dab ma rnams la/ phag mo/ /gshin rje ma/ rmongs byed ma/ bskyod byed ma/ bkrag byed ma/ tsanṭi ka rnams rim pas/ dmar sngo dkar ser ljang khu dud kha'i mdog can/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /tshangs pa gser mdog bram ze'i gzugs kyis rnga yab g.yob pa/ drag po dkar po mig gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan can/ thal mal ba'i cha lugs kyis stong pa/ 'phrog byed dmar po lha'i lus la seng ge'i gdong can/ ral gri mchan khung du bzung nas thal mo sbyar ba/ brgya byin ljang khu mig stong can e na ya'i lpags pas dkrid pas gdugs dkar 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang ro langs gar byed pa dang*/ lce spyang glu len pa dang*/ sgrub pa po gtor ma dang*/ zas mchog 'bul ba dang*/ mkha' lding gnod sbyin rig 'dzin 'byung po ma mo rnams kyi brjed par byed pa dang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ phaiṃ/ zhes 'og min nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ lte bar oṃ baṃ phag mo/ snying gar haṃ oṃ gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ skrag byed ma/ yan lag kun la phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇḍi ka /'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams phyir phyung*/ lha mor gyur pas mchod par bsam ste/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas yig chung ltar rdzogs rim sgom la/ skyo na bzlas pa bya ste rang gi lte bar sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor lta bu sgom nas/ oṃ gsum gyi bdag nyid yi ge so gnyis pa kho na bzla'o/ /phyi nas bgrang phreng dang ngag tu brjod pa med par sngags yid kyi bsam nas bzla ba ni yid bzlas so/ /de nas thams cad gsal stong du bsdus nas ldang ba'i tshe/ oṃ gsum gyi sngags brjod cing*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ gzugs dang sgra dang dran rtog thams cad sku gsung thugs so/ / zhes mos nas/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /de ltar zla ba drug tu snying po 'bum phrag bzhi bzla zhing sgom pas sems brtan par 'gyur la/ de ltar na bde ba dam pa thob bo zhes so/ /mdo tsam du ni 'dir gzhung kho na las kha bskang ba rnams med kyang rung gsung ba ltar ro/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga ste dang po'o/ /phyi rol mchod pa ni/ dus rgyun du'am khyad par gyi dus tshes bcu la sogs pa la/ mdun du stegs bu bshams/ yo byad thams cad tshogs pa dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs sems sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag bskyed rdzogs pa dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na badzra krodha hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes lag pa sa la reg bgegs bskrad de stong par mos/ hūṃ glurablangs nas skor ba byas te/ hūṃ las rdo rje nas/ mud ga ra 'i bar sgrub thabs ltar sgom pa ni srung ba'o/ /de nas 'og gzhi maṇḍal sa la bri/ der mandi la sogs pa la/ thod pa myos byed kyi bkang ba de'i steng du me long gi dkyil 'khor bzhag go /de rnams kyi ji ltar bya tshul gong gi phyi rol mchod pa ltar bya/ de nas/ oṃ bi ṭho ba bi ḍā ya swāhā sogs dang*/ de'i rjes su sumbha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung zhes pa nas/ baṃ dmar po zhes pa'i bar gang ltar/ de las rdo rje phag mo nas tsaṇḍi ka 'i bar yang gong bzhin no/ /de nas mchod pa bde mchog ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul tshul ni rngon pa'i gdams ngag gis yig snar bkod pa ltar ste khyad par ni gtor ma'i skabs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags/ oṃ gsum gyi bdag nyid snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags nas 'bul/ mchod pa re re'i mthar mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dang khyad par 'di lta bu zhig stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ me tog la sogs pa re re zhing rdzas dang sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin ma chad cing ma nor bar/ drug brgya bdun cu don lnga re 'bul ba ni/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i tshe nges par dgos la/ bsnyen pa dang*/ gzhan gyi skabs ci rigs la ma byung yang rung ngo*/ khyad par bsgrub pa la ni/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma kha sbyor las 'byung ba'am/ kun spyod lam 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor nyid/ mtshan mo gzhi mdo dang*/ dur khrod la sogs par lan 'bum la sogs pa'i bar du phul bas 'bras bu shin tu che gsung*/ gzhan yang bka' sdod nag po chen po'i ro langs 'jigs byed la gtor ma 'bul te/ de'i tshul ni 'og nas ston no/ /gtor ma dang bcas phyi rol mchod pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /sbyin sreg rgyas pa ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa gzhan du bri bar 'dod la/ gzhung gzhan las shin tu bsdus pa me mar gyi bsregs blugs kyang rung par bshad pas de yang bya mod/ gzhan du shes la/ de bzhin du za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro yang ngo*/ /'dir nang dang phyi las nang ni bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ltar sgoms la/ kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la bza' ba yin/ phyi 'bring po ni/

dngos grub kyi don du thab ni zur gsum dmar po kho na yin/ de yang sa gzhi bgegs sbyangs ba rdzogs pa yan chad phyi rol mchod pa ltar bya/ de nas bum pa bsgrubs nas thab khung gru gsum khru gang rgya phyed dpangs/ kha khyer dang mu ran la sna tshogs rdo rje dang gri gug gis mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa bya/ bum bskyed ltar bum pa bsgrubs pa las/ sumbha lan stong sogs bzlas pa'i bum pa de thab kyi g.yas su bzhag /bud shing rnams bkod la/ thab bsangs sbyangs bskyed/ der me spar la/ raṃ las me lha dmar po spyi blugs mchog spyin/ dbyug pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'i phyag bzhi pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lte bar oṃ baṃ sogs/ shar lho nas med lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ agni de ba ta ā karṣā ya dzāḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ byon zan dbul/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mos bum pa'i dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ oṃ shrī he ru ka agna ye swāhā/ zhes dgang blugs bdun phul/ phyi rol mchod pa ltar byin rlabs byas nas/ nyer spyod dang nang mchod dbul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshang dbang sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ sreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor ba/ 'bru gsum dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā sa byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ agne de wa ta swāhā zhes pa kho nas thams cad 'bul zhing las bcol/ dgang blugs gsum gyis mi lta 'bar ba'am/ shar lhor bzhugs par sgom pa dang lto ba rab tu yangs pa rnams gang rung sgom/ de nas sumbha sa bsangs ba nas/ gtor ma grub pa'i bar phyi rol mchod pa ltar las/ 'bar ba'i dbus su zhes sam/ lto ba yangs par e las sogs brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /sreg rdzas 'bul ba'ang sngar dang 'dra ba las sngags ni/ oṃ gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bidma he bidya rā dza ya/

dhī ma he pra tso dā ya swāhā/ de nas mchod bstod bzod par gsol la gshegs so/ /slar 'jig rten pa mchod pa ni/ cung zad tsam gyi khyad par ltar shes nas gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dngos grub kyi don du grangs tshad med pa dang*/ las kyi don du phyogs bzhi re rer 'bum bdun khri 'bum bdun khri dbul bas nges par 'grub ste/ de ltar na sbyin sreg ste gsum pa'o/ /gal te slob ma rjes su 'dzin na ni bdag bskyed dang*/ phyi rol mchod pa rdzogs par byas la/ bum pa bsgrub/ de nas 'grub na gzhon nu ma'i ston mo dang sbyin sreg bya/ mi 'grub na mtshams de nas/ bdag 'jug blang ngo*/ /de la bum pa sgrub tshul ni bsangs sbyangs/ bum par mdun skyed ltar lha bskyed nas/ mchod bstod bsdus pa gcig bya/ dung chos su oṃ tāpte tāpte mahā tāpte swāhā gāṅga'i rgyun 'bab par gyur/ de nas bzlas pa byas la/ gtor ma phul/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas bzod par gsol/ me tog dkar po gsum dang bcas pas sngar/ dung chos kyis mchod yon phul bas rjes su chags pas zhu ste/ chos 'byung gsang ba'i bha ga bum pa dang lha mo 'khor bcas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu bor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ de nas byin rlabs dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa rdzogs pa yan chad rngon pa'i gdams ngag dang 'dra/ khyad par ni/ mna' chu blud pa'i rjes la/ sumbha brjod cing bsangs chus 'thor/ de yang phreng ba ji lta ba'am/ yang na/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye badzra si ṣya sya sarba pā paṃ bhāsmin ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas til/ bhasmin ku ru 'i gnas su/ a pa nā ya swāhā/ zhes pas yungs kar chu dang bcas pa'i seng ras dang*/ kham phor dang*/ dur ba'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i lci changs rnams rim pas bya/ oṃ puṣtiṃ ka ri badzra shi ṣa sya/ pun+ya dzñā na saṃ bha ra ḍho pa kā ya swāhā rnams bzed zhal du bzhag /chu bzhin dbul/

dril bu sil zhing bzed zhal g.yon du skor la/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra swāhā/ zhes phyi dor/ puṣpe sogs me tog spyi bor bzhag / hūṃ bdun dang*/ las thams cad pa'i sardza rā dza 'i bdug pa dang mar me skor ro/ /de ltar drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba byas rjes/ rtogs pas g.yogs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir ldog ltar/ /dad pa'i chu yis bkrus pa'i sems/ /phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya/ /dad pa med pa'i sems can la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste/ /ji ltar sa bon tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po skye mi srid/ /de bas na dad pa bskyed par bya'o/ / zhes brjod pa khyad par ro/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal phul/ mngon rtogs ji lta ba 'bogs pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes pa bor/ de nas slob mas/ byang chub rdo rje'i sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ / zhes sogs bya/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal bas/ bum pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ snying po la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tsakra bī ra staṃ/ zhes pas dbang bskur bas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

de nas bzlas lung spyi dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na dngos bstan yin gsung ste/ lte bar sems dpa' gsum rtsig tu byas la sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs/ phyi nang gi zhal du zhugs/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de las byung nang dang phyi'i bha ga nas byung*/ lte bar chos 'byung gi nyi ma la 'khod par bsam nas/ rjes zlos lan gsum bya ba yin no/ / de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'od zer sna lngas mtshan pa'i bdud rtsir spyan drangs/ gtso mo'i dpral mgrin snying ga lte ba gsang ba'i thig le dang 'dres/ de rnams byang sems su zhu ba la khar dbab par bsam la/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum brtags pas bdud rtsi sbyin/ sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dga' ba 'khyil ba las slob dpon gyi ming med g.yon pas blangs te/ slob ma'i gnas bzhir snying po brjod cing thig le bya/ sindhu ra'i maṇḍal spyi bor bzhag ste/ ka sogs yi ges bskor te/ sprul pa'i rtsibs can nyi dbang dkyil 'khor la zhugs shing*/ 'bar ba'i me ltar rab 'bar bdud rtsi 'dzag pa padma'i skud pa ltar phra ba/ /rig ma sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bsregs shing 'khor lo gsum po byed pa gang yin pa/ /kun dga' dang bcas rol pas gyen gshegs phag mo 'di yi sems la gsal gyur cig / zhes brjod slob ma/ rang gi lte ba'i chos 'byung gi 'od ro ma nas brgyud nas phag gdong gi smin mtshams kyi dga' ba 'khyil ba la rgyab pas g.yas su 'khor bar bsam la/ rlung 'dzin du bcug / dga' 'khyil de dbu ma'i lam nas zhugs/ lte 'og tu 'khor ba la yang sems bzhag / der dga' ba bzhi'i myong ba dang sre ba'am mos pa bya/ 'di ni mngon rtogs kyi skabs su'ang sgom ste gzhan dang mthun no/ /de nas/ de'i 'od kyis phyi rol snang ba rang la thim/ lus yas mas thams cad lte bar thim ste stong pa la 'jog / yang sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes mos la lha skur ldang*/

de nas maṇḍal phul la dge ba bsngo rjes chog ni spyi dang mthun/ /snga ma'i sindhu ra'i rgyun phyi ma la yod na byin rlabs che gsung*/ rang gi bdag 'jug gi tshul cho ga de rdzogs par byas shing*/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar tshogs 'khor dang*/ sbyin sreg sogs sngar bshad pa ltar grangs tshang ba lan bdun gyis bsags rgyab dman pas kyang 'grub par gsungs te sngon du bsnyen pa grub pas so/ /byin rlabs sgom pa ste bzhi pa'o/ /gdags pa'i srung ba ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug mu khyud phyi rol pad 'dab brgyad/ rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pa/ lte bar baṃ/ rtsibs rnams la g.yas skor gyis go cha'i sa bon/ mu khyud la hūṃ kho na bris/ sa bon rnams la rang rang gi mdun nas brtsams te sngags kyi tha mar che ge mo gnod pa sogs 'di ltar bu las rakṣa ku ru zhes pa hūṃ gnyis kyi bar du chud pa bris te/ gro ga la gi haṃ ngam gur gum gyis so/ /rab gnas ni/ mchod gtor bshams/ bdag bskyed sgom/ bsang sbyangs zla ba la/ baṃ dkar po las/ bris pa ji lta bar bskyed/ lha'i ngo bor mos/ ye shes pa yang 'khor lo'i rnam par bstims/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul/ de nas ming yig bsgrub bya'i ngo bor mos la dbang bskur te gzungs thag brtags la 'bug phug sogs ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /mthar brtan bzhugs su pra tiṣṭha bzlas te/ mchod bstod bkra shis byas la/ btab nas dkris byas te/ mgo bo'am dpung par gdags pa'am/ kham phor dkar por sgrub tshul spyi mthun du bya'o/ /gdags pa'i srung 'khor te lnga pa'o/ /drag shul sbyor ba la sbyor ba gsum gcig tu gril bsrung*/ 'di la ting 'dzin chas gos sogs/ las kyi khyad par bcu tshang bas sgrub cing*/ sum bha'i 'khor lo ni/ rigs ldan che ba dang 'dra/ yang na dbyangs gsal 'khor lo dpe chung ltar bri/ 'khor lo de nyid dang*/ gshin rje 'khor lo le'u tshe bcu bdun pa/ dbus su phag mo gtso 'khor bdun gyi sa bon spel tshig raṃ phaṭa ghu gnyis kyi nang du chud pa dang*/

mu khyud phyi ma la snying po spel tshig can gyis bskor/ me re'i nang du ghu phaṭa kho na bri'o/ /'dir rang rje btsun ma nag mo gshed po thod dbyug 'dzin pa brgyad dang lha mo rnal 'byor ma brgyad/ re re'i mdun du ma mo brgyad dang*/ gshin rje brgyad kyis bskor bar bsam pa sgrub thabs ji lta bar bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs zhe sdang gshed po dang go ldog gi 'khyud pa gcig sgom/ bsgrub pa grub nas drag po'i sbyin sreg gi thab kyi 'og gam/ g.yos khang chen po'i thab 'og tu gnon no/ /de'i spogs chog /phur bu gcig gam/ lnga'am/ bdun nam/ bcu gcig gi sgrub pa bya/ dgra bo'i dri ma sogs las/ gzugs brnyan bya dgug gzhug sogs kyi mthar/ gnas lnga phur bus gdab/ kha sbyor dbye ba byas la bsgrub/ de nas chu mig gi khyad par zhig tu sbas la bka' bsgo'o/ / sngar gyi 'khrul 'khor dang 'dra ba rgya skyegs kyi ril bur bcug pa bdun yang sgrub nas zla ba re re zhing chu mig tu dor bas/ tha mas nges par 'grub bo/ /yang spogs pa ni/ bsnyen pa song nas nag po chen po sgrub ste/ mngon rtogs kyi skabs gtso mo'i mdun du/ hūṃ las nag po chen po ro langs 'jigs byed bka' non pa'i tshul skem zhing khros pa/ phyag gsum pa g.yas dang pos rtse gsum gnyis pas gri skyog po/ g.yon pas ka pā la sha chen gyis gang ba/ bya rog gi tshogs spro ba/ khyi nag gis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng na rol pas gar mdzad cing*/ phyogs bzhir skyes bu gsal zhing la btsugs pa/ wa rnams sgra 'byin pa dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis bskor ba'o/ /hriḥkaṃ kaṃ baṃ beṃ rnams las bha gī nīs 'khyud pa/ kā li dang*/ ka ra lī dang bha ra ḍī dang*/ bai ta li rnams gri thod bsnams pas bskor ba'o/ / rang gi bdag bskyed rdzogs pa dang*/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren dam gzhag dbang bskur/ mchod gtor phul la/ las bcol/

mchod gtor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ shrī kṣe i dam bā ling gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ mahā maṃ sa puṣpe dhū pe dī pe/ rakṣa tā la pa tā le/ aṣta nā ga /de ba yakṣa rakṣa sa/ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya i dam bā liṃ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ kha kha khā hī khā hi hūṃ dza phaiṃ mahā aṭṭaṭṭa hā sa/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tapdza ya tapdza ya/ oṃ kriṣṇa bharṇa phaiṃ phaiṃ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags ni/ shā sa na 'o/ /drag sngags ni 'jig rten pa rnams kyi ste/ dag las shes/ /'dis 'jig rten pa'i gtor sngags kyang rung ngo*/ /der rtsa sngags/ snying po/ drag sngags rnams 'bum du bzlas la/ slad nas/ yang rang nyid sgom nas mtshan ma dmigs kyi bar bzla'o/ /de nas nag po'i tshes la/ stan nag po la 'dug /ba byung lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ dri bzang dang gri khrag gis chag chag btab pa'i stegs bu la gzhon nu ma'i rdul dang ro sol gyis dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas la/ me tog nag po'i gdan lnga tshom bu bkod/ sha chen gyis spos dang*/ gtor ma sogs bshams/ bdag mdun gnyis ka rdzogs nas/ mchod gtor phul la bzlas pa la 'bad/ thun mtshams su tshogs 'khor bya ste/ 'di bsnyen bsgrub sbrags ma ste/ zla drug sogs bya/ de nas thun dang po la/ bdag bskyed dran tsam bya/ de nas nga rgyal de tsam la gnas pas/ mdun bskyed kho na sgrub ste/ mthar drag tu bskul ba mang du bya/ rang nyid tshogs 'khor sogs kyi tshe sgrub grogs yod na de bzlas pa dang bskul ba byed du gzhug go /'di rgyun mi 'chad du byas pas nges par zhag bdun sogs la rtags 'byung ste/ de nas las sbyor bya'o/ /dgra bo'i dri ma bdun po gang rnyed dang*/ rdo dang lcags dang zangs dang*/ tsha ba gsum dang*/ gro phye las/ ling ga byas pa'i snying gar dug dang ske tshe dang*/ gri khrag dang bya rog gi khrag dang rgya skyegs kyis mi pags la 'khor lo man ngag ltar bri/ 'khor lo skyed chog rab gnas dkris sogs drag las spyi dang 'dra/

de ling ga'i snying gar bcug la bu ga bkag /de'i bshang lam nas spyi bor gsal shing las byung ba'am/ lcags kyi :gtsangs [rtsang ]kyis 'khor lo la ma gnod par phug /mi rus kyi phur bu yang sgrub pa byas nas bzhag /dug dang khrag chen gyis byugs pa'i tsher ma sngags kyis bsgrubs pas lus bkang nas/ lhor sor bcu gnyis pa'i dong zur gsum pa/ ro sol gyis byugs par bcug la sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan/ de nas bsam gtan gyi las tshogs bzlas pa dang bcas gtso 'khor gyi sngags kun dang dgug bzhugs gzhug dang*/ khrag sna thal chen/ yungs kar rnams kyis thun gyi brab pa dang*/ mi rus kyis phur bus brdab pa rnams byas la/ de ltar zhag gsum dang lnga dang bdun bar ma chad du bya/ slar rab chad kyi thod pa kha sbyor du bcug la/ dgug bzhugs dang*/ kha sbyor phye nas sku las spros pa'i khwa dang khyi dang*/ gtum po/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gri gug gis btub pa dang za ba'i bar byed par bsams shing*/ rnam par shes pa dbyings su spar la/ sngags ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi gong du che ge mo mā ra ya zhes pa gzhug ste/ thun bsdu khar sprul pa rnams 'khor lo la bcug nas mchod gtor phul la bzod gsol byas te/ ling ga sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan no/ /de yang thun bzhir bsgrubs pas/ 'gul ba sogs mthong na/ mahā kā la mchod nas/ yang ling ga lcags kyis phug /lcags lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ lag pa g.yas pas tsher ma dang thun gyis bsnun nas gsang sngags bzla'o/ /mtshan phyed kyi dus su/ thab kyi thugs ka nas me byung bas brdungs par bsams shing*/ dur khrod kyi me'i rgyun gyi 'bras phub kyi me la gdung ba zhag bdun bya me ma shi ba byed gsung*/ de nas ling ga dang 'khor lo de gshin rje la gtad pa'am/ sbyin sreg bya'am gtor mar dbul ba gang yang rung ba byas pas nges par 'grub ste/ gal te zhig rgya la ma 'grub na/

khro bo hūṃ mdzad kyi zhal du nag po chen po'i gzugs 'bul ba'i sbyin sreg byed de des ni mi 'grub pa mi srid gsung*/ sgrubs pa'i skabs nag po chen po/ rtse gsum kha thur ltas la gnas pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs khyi la bzhon pa/ g.yas g.yon du rang dang 'dra ba la/ phyag gsum gar na gsal shing re re bzung ba sgom pa yin no/ /drag shul gyi skabs 'dir mi gsal ba cung zad zhal las shes pa dang*/ ma mo dang gshin rje'i 'khor lo'i skabs/ kha bskong dgos pa ches mang ba yod do/ /'dir mahā kā la'i drag shul sbyor ba 'di gzhung gi dngos bstan la med kyang*/ man ngag /gzhal gdams yin cing*/ skabs 'dir 'byung pos 'dzin pa dang smyo bar byed pa gnyis gsung ste/ 'dir ma bris so/ /de ltar drag shul gyi sbyor ba ste drug pa'o/ /sgom pa'i phyir zlog ni/ mngon rtogs rdzogs pa dang*/ snying ga'i baṃ las/ bhruṃ spros/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gnyis/ nang ma rtsibs bzhi la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ phyi ma bcu la sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang*/ mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma rnams/ 'di rnams gzhan las 'byung ba bzhin/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi bskyed nas/ 'khor lo skor zhing sngags bzlas te/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye sarba duṣtan staṃ bha ya pra tyaṃ gi ra hrīḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla la gzhan ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bri ba'i zlog pa ni/ bsgoms pa ltar 'khor lo rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pa la sngags sngar gyi lha'i rim pas bris/ che ge mo la gnod pa'i sngags dang*/ 'khrul 'khor ngan pa byed pa thams cad pra tyaṃ gi ra hrīḥzhes sam mā ra ya/ st+waṃ bha ya bandha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bris nas bsgrubs pa ni spyi dang 'dra ste sngags dang lha'i khyad tsam mo/ /de yang rdul gyi ras la gur gum dang tsan dan dmar pos bris/ rdo rwa me ri'i phyi ma/ phyogs re rer sngags thams cad la hūṃ che ge mo la rakṣa hūṃ zhes spel lo/

/mthar sgrub pa'am 'dogs pa gang rung bya'o/ /phyir zlog pa ste bdun pa'o/ /tshogs mchod ni dang por gzhon nu ma yi mchod pa bya la/ de yang gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ste mdor bsdus rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi yig snar bkod zin la/ mchod pa'i skabs btung ba dang*/ mgo la sku ba dang dri'i byugs pa dang*/ mig sman dang*/ sindhu ra'i thig le dang*/ gos dmar po dang*/ me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang*/ so rtsi sogs dngos su sbyin no zhes pa ni lag len no/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs dpa' bo drug dang rnal 'byor ma drug ces gsungs pa ni/ slob dpon ma gtogs pa ste tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ / mang po yod na lha re re la gnyis gnyis sogs byas pas rung zhing*/ gang ltar mtshan mo'i dus sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ byin dbab zhu 'bul dang*/ bdag bskyed dang phyi rol mchod pa gtor ma bcas pa dang*/ tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ lha la 'bul ba dang*/ tshogs byin len du byed pa dang*/ mahā bhai ra ba ro langs 'jigs byed mchod pa dang*/ longs spyod pa dang*/ brda dang glu gar bya ba dang*/ rjes chags dang*/ lhag gtor ma mo dgu dang*/ 'byung po sogs la sbyin te cho ga ni spyi dang mthun no/ /tshogs kyi bya ba grub pa na/ slob dpon gyis byin rlabs byas nas bde stong dbang bzhi pa nyams su blangs pas skya rengs shar ba'i tshe phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes/ gang zag lam mthon por song ba'i khyad par dang ldan pa zhig gis nye rgyu sgrub tshul gyi 'phros la tshogs 'khor gsungs pa ste/ tshogs mchod dang spyod pa ste brgyad pa'o/ /bsnyen pa dang las rim bdun te/ sgrub thabs las bdun can gyi man ngag gi gnas tsam thams cad stan zin to/ /'di'i man ngag gi zhal gdams ci rigs pa zhig da dung yod snang bas rnyed na bstan par bya'o/ /ngag 'don nam nag 'gros su bris na tshogs che bas 'dir mdo tsam ste lag len mthong ba las shes so/

/smras pa/ khengs ldan rnams ni yi ge tsam lta ste/ /man ngag med na de dag rnam par 'khyams/ /rang bzo kun la man ngag mchog go zhes/ /deng sang rab rmongs phal cher 'di na smra/ / rgyud don yin yang man ngag zhal gdams te/ /gzhan la med kyang gzhan dang mi 'gal ba/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis ci phyir 'di mi brten/ /phyogs 'dzin can rnams ci dgar byed la reg/ces pa'ang smras so/ /'gro la rtag tu phan pa'i don/ /man ngag gsal bar bris pa yi/ /dge bas 'gro kun mchog thob shog /'khrul na 'phags mas bzod pa'i rigs/ /zhes pa'ang dpal stag lung thang pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis kyis zhal snga nas bka' stsal spyi bos nod de/ tā ra nā thas gu ru lho phyogs pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa ni rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o/ /zhus dag/ka lyā ṇa wa rdha ཾ/ maṅga la bast+rār// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs chung ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 48 -- PAGE 61 -- PAGE 47 -
